verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs link a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the Cloud Agents API, and a same-day probe confirmed it returns HTTP 200 as machine-readable YAML. The Origin API also publishes its own OpenAPI spec plus llms.txt files. Missing for 10: no evidenced OpenAPI specs for the Admin, Analytics, AI Code Tracking, or Bugbot APIs, so spec coverage across the full API surface is unproven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: View the full OpenAPI specification (/docs-static/cloud-agents-openapi.yaml) for detailed schemas and examples
GET https://cursor.com/docs-static/cloud-agents-openapi.yaml returns HTTP 200 machine-readable YAML: "openapi: 3.0.3 / info: / title: Cursor Cloud Agents API
The Origin API publishes its own llms.txt/llms-full.txt and an OpenAPI spec (cursor.com/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml, "Public third-party-facing Origin API", v1alpha1, servers: api.cursor.com).
